split_rule: ascending sha256(namespace + ':' + decimal image_id), tie by image_id; first7500 fit
ridge_loss: sum squared error + alpha times squared coefficient norm
target: unit L2 normalized CLIP ViT-L/14 image embeddings; raw endpoint GT preprocessing
standardization: StandardScaler fit only on fitting rows; drop exactly zero variance columns from those rows
pca_reuse: unsupervised scaler/PCA shared across label permutations only within identical fit scope and dimension
selection_metric: mean forward cosine two-way identification on fixed1000 tune pool
selection_ties: exact ties choose256 then larger alpha
shuffle_rule: default_rng(seed).permutation on fit labels for tuning; seed+1000000 on full8500 refit labels; never shuffle held-out targets
controls: each permutation repeats all10 candidate fits and tune selection, then refits selected on8500; mean uses fit mean for tuning and8500 mean for validation
retrieval: prediction rows vs GT columns, float64 cosine, exact ties half in two-way; top-k expected uniform tie rank
candidate_aggregation: score each candidate then average per image; never average embeddings
scope: exploratory reused internal validation, conditional on this sample and models; five shuffles descriptive, no permutation p-value
